source: Rebuilt faithfully from PAPOT_Template_Devis_V1.docx visual/layout reference

dynamicAnchors.PAPOT_QUOTE_BODY: Replace anchor row with ordered SECTION, SUBSECTION, LINE, COMMENT and PHOTO rows. Preserve rich-text runs and newlines.
dynamicAnchors.PAPOT_OPTIONS_BLOCK: Replace anchor row/table contents with options only. Options are excluded from main total.
dynamicAnchors.PAPOT_VAT_SUMMARY: Main summary label/value area. Generator should replace with aggregated VAT amount or a compact label when a single rate exists.
dynamicAnchors.PAPOT_VAT_LINES_ANCHOR: Insert one row per VAT rate when multiple rates exist, then remove the anchor row.
dynamicAnchors.PAPOT_QR_ACTIONS_BLOCK: Optional future QR/sign/share block. Remove when unused.
dynamicAnchors.PAPOT_ANNEX_IMAGES: Optional client-visible image annex. Remove when unused.

layoutRules: Quote table header repeats on multipage output.
Dynamic rows must never use fixed row heights.
Section/subsection headings should stay with the following row when possible.
Line descriptions keep explicit newlines and rich-text styling.
Internal pricing adjustments are never rendered as separate client rows.
Options are visually separated and excluded from total_ht/total_ttc/net_a_payer.
CGV page text is static source content from PAPOT_Template_Devis_V1 and uses societe_nom replacement only.
vatStrategy: Default VAT is snapshotted from the client at quote creation; PAPOT_QUOTE_BODY renders the effective VAT per line; PAPOT_VAT_LINES_ANCHOR renders aggregated VAT totals by rate.
